name: sp-smoke
title: Single player: the main menu and every settings page, then a skirmish played, paused and quit

runtime_files.write:
DataModule
	ModuleName = User Scenes
	ScanFolderContents = 1
	IgnoreMissingItems = 1
	AddActivity = GAScripted
		CopyOf = P4 Alpha Duel
		PresetName = Determinism FeelBaseline
		ScriptPath = UserScenes.rte/FeelBaseline.lua
		LuaClassName = FeelBaseline
		IsTestActivity = 1
		TeamOfPlayer1 = 0
		Player1IsHuman = 1
		TeamOfPlayer2 = 1
		Player2IsHuman = 1

checklist.what: the main menu is on screen with its buttons drawn and no loading artefacts
each of Video, Audio, Input, Gameplay, Misc and Network is shown with its rows inside its box
checklist.assert: menu script: assert_settings_page <page> and assert_visible CollectionBox<page>Settings 1

checklist.what: the Network page's five sub-pages (Player, Chat, Recovery, Files, Internet) each show their box
Back returns to the main menu with nothing left drawn over it
the skirmish activity picker (ScenarioGUI) is opened from the main menu and a match is started from it
checklist.blocked_by: ScenarioGUI has no menu-automation seam: the menu script pump stops while it is up, so this leg cannot be driven or asserted. The play run below boots the activity directly instead.

checklist.what: the skirmish is played: actors walk, aim, jump, crouch, fire and swap weapons; the HUD is drawn
checklist.assert: input script tools/e2e/play-input.txt drives both seats

checklist.what: Escape opens the pause menu and its rows (Resume, Settings, Save or Load, Mod Manager, Back to Main) are inside the panel
checklist.assert: probe: assert_visible/assert_rect_inside on each pause row

checklist.what: every pause settings page (Video, Audio, Input, Gameplay, Misc) is shown mid-match
Resume closes the pause menu and the match keeps running from where it paused
the run leaves the match and quits cleanly, with exit code 0 and no assert dialog
